text: The user finished binge-watching the third season of 'The Crown' on Netflix in 14 days, starting on a Sunday afternoon and watching at least 2-3 episodes every day. They asked for new shows similar to 'The Crown'.

The assistant recommended ten shows similar to 'The Crown', framed as royal and historical drama: Victoria (Netflix), Downton Abbey, The White Princess (Starz), Outlander, The Tudors (Showtime), Poldark (BBC), The Last Kingdom (Netflix), Versailles (Canal+ and Netflix), The Spanish Princess (Starz) and Reign (The CW).
As of 20 May 2023, the user had been subscribed to HBO Max for about six months, since around November 2022, and was re-watching some of their favourite episodes of 'Friends' on it.
The user said they had seen some of the shows the assistant listed for 'The Crown' but had not watched all of them, and would check out the ones they had not seen yet.

The assistant recommended ten sitcoms similar to 'Friends': How I Met Your Mother, New Girl, Schitt's Creek, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, Parks and Recreation, The Good Place, Fleabag, Silicon Valley, Arrested Development and 30 Rock, and said most are on Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video or HBO Max.
The user said they had seen some of the sitcoms recommended and would check out the ones not yet watched. They then asked for fantasy shows similar to 'Game of Thrones'.

The assistant recommended ten fantasy shows similar to 'Game of Thrones': Westworld (HBO), Outlander, Vikings, The Witcher (Netflix), Shadow and Bone (Netflix), The Shannara Chronicles (MTV), American Gods (Starz), Penny Dreadful, The Magicians (Syfy) and Carnival Row (Amazon Prime Video).

The user said they watch a lot of TV and want to check out documentaries on Hulu, especially true crime and science. The last one they watched was about the life of Ted Bundy, which they found really disturbing but also fascinating.

The assistant recommended eight true crime documentaries and series: The Jinx (HBO), Making a Murderer (Netflix), The Keepers (Netflix), The Staircase (Netflix), The Innocent Man (Netflix), The Confession Tapes (Netflix), I Am a Killer (Netflix) and The First 48 (A&E).

The assistant recommended eight science documentaries: Cosmos: A Spacetime Odyssey (National Geographic, hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson), Planet Earth (BBC), The Human Body (BBC), Wild Wild Country (Netflix), The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley (HBO), Free Solo (National Geographic), The Last Lions (National Geographic) and Challenger: The Final Flight (Netflix).

As of 20 May 2023, the user had been watching a lot of TV across several streaming services and had recently discovered Amazon Prime Video's original content. They had just finished 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' and loved its well-developed characters and engaging storyline.

The assistant said the performances of Rachel Brosnahan and Alex Borstein in 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' are outstanding, and recommended Amazon Prime Video originals: The Expanse, Fleabag, Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan, The Grand Tour, The Big Sick, Sneaky Pete, The Man in the High Castle and Bosch.

The user has been listening to a lot of music and podcasts on Spotify. They recently discovered a playlist called 'Lo-Fi Beats', which they have been playing nonstop while working or studying, and have been exploring the podcasts 'How I Built This' and 'Stuff You Should Know'.

The assistant said 'How I Built This' (hosted by Guy Raz) and 'Stuff You Should Know' (hosted by Josh and Chuck) are excellent, and recommended The Tim Ferriss Show, My Favorite Murder, Radiolab, The Daily, Hidden Brain, Hardcore History, The TED Radio Hour and StarTalk Radio.

As of 20 May 2023, the user was looking for new shows on HBO Max. They had started 'Game of Thrones' about a month earlier, around late April 2023, had finished the first four seasons and were really enjoying it, and asked for similar recommendations.

The assistant recommended seven HBO Max shows similar to 'Game of Thrones': Westworld, Vikings, Rome, Outlander (a World War II nurse who time-travels to 18th-century Scotland), The Last Kingdom, His Dark Materials and Carnival Row.
The user said they had been watching documentaries on Hulu, particularly true crime and science, and asked for documentary recommendations on HBO Max.

The assistant recommended HBO Max true crime documentaries I'll Be Gone in the Dark, The Case Against Adnan Syed and The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst, and science and technology titles Chernobyl, The Planets and Axios.
The assistant also recommended the HBO Max documentaries The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley, Jane Fonda in Five Acts and The Apollo, the last being about the Apollo Theater in Harlem.

As of 20 May 2023, the user said they were glad to have HBO Max, Hulu and Amazon Prime Video to explore. They had just finished 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' and loved it, and asked for other comedy recommendations on Amazon Prime.

The assistant said Amy Sherman-Palladino, creator of 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel', also created Gilmore Girls, and recommended Amazon Prime comedies: Fleabag, Gilmore Girls, Schitt's Creek, Good Omens, Upload, Catastrophe and Red Oaks.

The user had been meaning to get back to re-watching favourite episodes of 'Friends' on HBO Max, a service they had been subscribed to for about six months, and asked for classic sitcom or comfort TV recommendations on it.

The assistant recommended HBO Max classic sitcoms The Big Bang Theory (all 12 seasons available), Seinfeld (all nine seasons available) and Frasier, comfort TV The Nanny, The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air and Roseanne, and nostalgic favourites The Wonder Years, The Brady Bunch and I Dream of Jeannie.

The user said they were thinking of re-watching some of those classic sitcoms and had been watching cooking shows on Netflix, particularly 'Nailed It!' and 'The Great British Baking Show', which they found entertaining and relaxing. They asked for cooking or food shows on HBO Max.

The assistant recommended HBO Max cooking and food shows: Bourdain's Parts Unknown, No Reservations, Giada at Home, Sweet Life: Los Angeles (from Issa Rae, creator of Insecure), Ugly Delicious, The World's Most Extraordinary Homes and The Chef's Table.

As of 20 May 2023, the user was thinking of exploring more food-related content on HBO Max and had recently discovered Amazon Prime Video's original content. They had just finished 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' and asked for other original recommendations on Amazon Prime Video.

The assistant recommended Amazon Prime Video TV originals The Expanse, Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan, The Grand Tour, The Man in the High Castle and Sneaky Pete, and movies Manchester by the Sea, The Big Sick, Cold War, The Report and One Night in Miami.

As of 22 May 2023, the user wanted help planning their morning routine for the week and asked for reminders for meditation and gym sessions. They usually do these right after waking at 6:30 AM on weekdays.

The assistant proposed a weekday routine: wake at 6:30 AM, meditate at 6:40 AM for 10-15 minutes, get ready for the gym at 7:00 AM and go to the gym at 7:30 AM. It suggested setting reminders and packing the gym bag or setting up the meditation space the night before.
The user wanted to add lunch preparation to the morning routine, which usually takes about 20 minutes, and asked for a suitable time slot.

The assistant suggested preparing lunch at 6:55 AM between meditation and the gym, with a 7:15 AM start to getting ready for the gym. The alternative was preparing lunch after the gym, around 8:00-8:20 AM.

The user chose the first option, lunch prep at 6:55 AM. The assistant recapped the weekday routine as 6:30 AM wake up, 6:40 AM meditation, 6:55 AM lunch prep (20 minutes), 7:15 AM get ready for the gym and 7:30 AM gym session.
As of 22 May 2023, the user said they were thinking of tracking their daily commute to optimise their route and schedule, and asked for help with that.

The assistant suggested commute tracking with Google Maps, Citymapper and Transit, keeping a commute journal of departure and arrival times, transport mode, route and delays, then reviewing the data after a week or two to adjust routes or schedules.

The user takes the 8:05 AM bus to work, which gets them to the office by 8:40 AM. In the week of 15 May 2023, they started a different route that adds about 10 minutes to the commute, but they prefer it because it is less crowded.

The assistant updated the weekday routine to add 8:00 AM get ready for work, 8:05 AM catch the bus to work and 8:40 AM arrive at the office, and said a more comfortable, less crowded ride can make a big difference.
As of 22 May 2023, the user wanted help creating a schedule for the day because they had a lot to fit in. They said that on Fridays they like to get a head start by waking at 6:00 AM.

The user needed to fit in a 45-minute workout, 30 minutes of meditation, getting ready for work and 20 minutes to prepare lunch. Their top priority was a project due by the end of 22 May 2023, which needed a few hours of focus.
The user had a daily team meeting at 9:00 AM on 22 May 2023 and wanted to grab a coffee and catch up on some news beforehand.

The assistant's first schedule for 22 May 2023 had a 6:00 AM wake-up, a 45-minute workout from 6:10 AM, meditation from 7:15 AM, lunch prep at 7:45 AM, coffee and news at 8:30 AM, the 9:00 AM team meeting, project work from 9:30 AM and lunch at 1:00 PM.

The user asked to move lunch to 12:30 PM to gain 30 minutes for the project. The assistant revised the schedule to allow 3.5 hours of project work from 9:30 AM, with lunch at 12:30 PM and project work resuming at 1:00 PM.
The assistant advised the user to take a real break at lunch to recharge and avoid burnout.
The user said the revised schedule with lunch at 12:30 PM should work for them and was glad to have fitted in the extra 30 minutes for the project.
The user asked to squeeze in 15 minutes of urgent email time between getting ready for work and grabbing a coffee, before the team meeting.
The assistant set email time at 8:20 AM for 15 minutes, moved coffee and news to 8:35 AM for 25 minutes, and kept the 9:00 AM team meeting and 12:30 PM lunch break in place.

The user said the final schedule should work perfectly and was glad to fit in the extra 15 minutes for urgent emails. The assistant encouraged them to take breaks, stay focused and meet the project deadline.

As of 23 May 2023, the user was thinking of cleaning their jewelry collection and asked for guidance or a recommended jewelry cleaning solution. They had received a new silver necklace with a small pendant on 15 April 2023 and wanted to take good care of it.

The assistant's general cleaning steps were to check the metal type and any treatments such as rhodium plating, gather a soft lint-free cloth, warm water and an optional soft-bristled toothbrush, soak for 15-30 minutes, gently scrub, rinse, then dry and buff.

The assistant recommended cleaning options: mild fragrance-free soap with warm water, commercial cleaners Goddard's Silver Dip, Weiman Jewelry Cleaner and Connoisseurs Jewelry Cleaner, a mix of 1 part white vinegar to 2 parts water, and silver-specific Goddard's Silver Polish or Hagerty Silver Dip.

For the silver necklace, the assistant advised avoiding bleach, acid and abrasives, drying it thoroughly, storing it in a cool dry place away from direct sunlight in a cloth pouch or airtight container, cleaning every 1-3 months and avoiding ultrasonic cleaners.
The user said they were thinking of taking photos of each jewelry piece to keep a record and asked for tips on how to do that.

The assistant's photography tips included natural window light, a clean plain white, grey or black background, a tripod, a macro lens or extension tubes, a softbox, a polarising filter or black cardboard to reduce reflections, and a reflector.

The assistant suggested organising jewelry photos in folders by category or date, using descriptive file names such as 'Silver Necklace with Pendant_2023-02-15.jpg', backing up to an external drive or cloud storage, and considering inventory apps such as Jewelplex or Jewelry Inventory.

The user was trying to locate a pair of earrings with little diamonds, a gift from their grandma, which they thought they left at their cousin's place after wearing them to her birthday party. They also asked how to keep track of jewelry when travelling or lending it.

The assistant suggested travel tips: a jewelry travel case, packing jewelry separately, making an inventory before travelling, wearing sentimental pieces, and using hotel safes. For lending, it suggested a written or digital note with description, value and date, a photo with the borrower, a set return date and a simple loan agreement.
As of 23 May 2023, the user planned to start by making a list of their jewelry and photographing each piece, and to contact their cousin to ask her to return the earrings.

The assistant advised asking the cousin politely with a friendly tone, an honest and casual explanation that the earrings were a gift from the user's grandma, a note of appreciation, and an offer to mail them or reimburse postage or treat her to coffee or lunch. It provided a sample message.

As of 23 May 2023, the user's engagement ring had been bought about a month earlier, around late April 2023, and was still a bit too loose, so the user asked how ring resizing works and what to expect.

The assistant listed resizing options as sizing up or down by adding or removing metal, cutting and re-soldering, or re-shanking, and said platinum and titanium are more challenging to resize than gold or silver. It advised checking the ring's material first.

The assistant said resizing costs can range from $20 to $200 or more, depending on metal, design and jeweler rates, and that the process typically takes a few days to a few weeks. It advised getting a written estimate and asking about warranties or guarantees.
The user planned to contact their cousin about the earrings and also contact the jeweler where they bought the engagement ring to ask about the resizing process.
As of 29 May 2023, the user was thinking of cleaning their jewelry collection that weekend, meaning the weekend of 3-4 June 2023, and was unsure of the best way to clean different types of jewelry.
The user got a new pair of emerald earrings at a flea market on the weekend of 27-28 May 2023 and was absolutely loving them.

The assistant's general jewelry tips were to handle pieces with clean dry hands or gloves, avoid bleach, acid and ammonia, use a soft lint-free microfiber cloth, and dry pieces thoroughly to prevent water spots.

The assistant's cleaning methods by type were: gold and silver with warm water, mild soap, a 15-30 minute soak and a soft toothbrush; pearls with a damp soft cloth and no soap, dried flat; and tarnished silver with a silver polishing cloth or a baking soda and water solution left for 15-30 minutes.

The assistant said diamonds and gemstones can be cleaned with a warm water and mild soap soak, but emeralds need a gentler approach because they can be prone to scratching. Ultrasonic cleaners should be used with caution on pearls, opals and emeralds.
The user said they wanted to take good care of the new emerald earrings and asked how to store them when not being worn to prevent scratching or damage.

The assistant advised storing each emerald earring separately in a soft padded pouch or compartment, using a velvet-lined jewelry box, keeping them away from direct sunlight and humidity, not storing them in a pile, and checking them regularly. It suggested a jewelry storage bag or roll for travel.
The user planned to take inventory of their jewelry collection and photograph each piece to keep a record, and asked for tips on capturing details.

The assistant's photography tips included natural window light, a softbox or diffused light, avoiding flash, a macro lens or close-up setting, ISO 100-400, an aperture of f/2.8 or lower, a plain neutral background, a tripod, a reflector, and editing in Adobe Lightroom or Photoshop.
The user said they would take note of the photography tips and asked for jewelry cleaning solutions or products safe to use on their emerald earrings.

The assistant said emeralds should not be cleaned with harsh chemicals, abrasive materials or hot water, and suggested a mild dish soap solution in warm water with a soft lint-free or microfiber cloth. It advised testing any product on a small inconspicuous area first.

The assistant listed commercial cleaners for emeralds: Connoisseurs Jewel Cleaners (Emerald & Gemstone Cleaner), Goddard's Silver Polish, Weiman Jewelry Cleaner (Emerald & Gemstone Cleaner) and Tarn-X Jewelry Cleaner (Emerald & Gemstone Cleaner). It warned against ultrasonic cleaners that use heat.
As of 29 May 2023, the user was thinking of getting a jewelry cleaning kit with a solution and soft cloth, and said they were really glad to have bought the emerald earrings at the flea market.

The assistant said a cleaning kit is a good idea if it is designed for emeralds and gemstones, and suggested having the emerald earrings appraised or certified by a professional jeweler or gemologist for insurance or a future sale.

As of 29 May 2023, the user said getting the emerald earrings appraised or certified is a great idea. They had been accumulating quite a few jewelry pieces over the years and wanted to organise and take inventory of their collection.

The assistant advised categorising jewelry by type (earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, brooches and watches), then by material or era, and recording description, value, date acquired, location and a photo for each piece in a spreadsheet.

The assistant advised storing jewelry in a cool dry place, wrapped in acid-free tissue or cloth in airtight containers or bags, and keeping inventory and appraisal documents in a fireproof safe or a bank safe deposit box.

As of 29 May 2023, the user needed help cleaning their gold chains and rings. They had got their engagement ring about a month earlier, around late April 2023, and it was still a bit too loose and needed resizing.

The assistant's gold cleaning tips were to avoid bleach, acid and abrasive cleaners, use a microfiber or soft lint-free cloth rather than paper towels, mix warm water with mild soap, optionally use a gold-specific cleaner, dry thoroughly, and check manufacturer instructions before using an ultrasonic cleaner.

The assistant's resizing advice was to visit the original jeweler or a reputable local jeweler, check whether the warranty covers resizing, consider a professional for the work, and expect a wait of a few days or weeks.
The user said they were thinking of taking inventory of their jewelry collection and photographing each piece, and asked for tips on how to organise and document it.

The assistant's organising tips were to categorise by type, metal, gemstone or material, and occasion or style, use storage containers with compartments such as velvet-lined trays, pouches or rolls, and label each container.

The assistant's documentation tips were to photograph each piece from multiple angles, record metal, gemstones, dimensions, weight, provenance, appraisal or purchase details and repairs, keep a spreadsheet or catalog, and store digital copies on an external drive, cloud storage or a password-protected folder.
The user said they were thinking of using a spreadsheet to document their jewelry and asked which columns or fields to include.
The assistant suggested basic spreadsheet columns: Item ID, Description, Type, Category, Metal, Purity, Gemstone(s), Other Materials, and dimensions of Length, Width and Weight.

The assistant suggested further spreadsheet columns for Purchase Date, Purchase Location, Appraisal Date, Appraisal Value, Provenance Notes, Last Cleaned, Last Serviced, Repair History, Insurance Value, Insurance Policy, Appraisal Document, Photo, Certificate of Authenticity, Notes, Location and Status.

As of 29 May 2023, the user said they would use Google Sheets so they can access the spreadsheet from anywhere and share it easily, and wanted to add a column for the occasion or event each piece was worn to.

The assistant said an occasion column helps track jewelry rotation, recall special moments and plan outfits, and suggested a consistent date format, a list of common events, and optional Last Worn, Wear Count and Storage columns.
The user decided to add a column for the storage location of each piece and a wear count column, to see which pieces are their favourites.

The assistant said a storage location column reduces clutter and prevents loss, and a wear count column helps identify favourites and discover unworn pieces. It suggested reviewing the spreadsheet every few months.
As of 29 May 2023, the user said they would add a column to track when each piece needs cleaning or maintenance, so they can keep their jewelry in good condition.

The assistant suggested maintenance columns Last Cleaned, Next Cleaning Due, Cleaning Notes and Maintenance History, and suggested setting reminders or notifications to keep cleaning and maintenance schedules.
